steps.message:
## Diagnosis

When an item is swiped away, `ItemTouchHelper` leaves the item view translated completely off screen (`translationX = ±recyclerView.getWidth()`, plus `alpha = 0.5` from `onItemSelected()`). That translation is only reset later, when `ItemTouchHelper.clearView()` runs — which happens when the swiped child view is detached from the window during the next `RecyclerView` layout pass.

If the swiped item was the **last** one in the list, `QueueFragment.onFragmentLoaded()` immediately did `recyclerView.setVisibility(View.GONE)` to show the empty view. A `GONE` view is skipped by its parent's measure/layout, so:

* the pending adapter update (`notifyItemRemoved`) is never processed,
* the child is never detached, so `clearView()` never resets the translation.

On "Undo", the item is re-inserted, the RecyclerView is made visible again and — because the adapters use stable IDs — the very same `ViewHolder` is reused (`getScrapOrCachedViewForId` returns the removed holder). It gets correct layout bounds but keeps the stale `translationX`, so the row is laid out *outside the screen*: exactly the reported "list contains an item, but it seems to be moved outside of the screen".

## Fix

1. **`QueueFragment.onFragmentLoaded()`** — never hide the `RecyclerView`. Only the empty `TextView` is toggled (it is drawn on top of the then-empty list). This keeps layout passes running so adapter updates and swipe cleanup are processed.
2. **`QueueRecyclerAdapter` / `AllEpisodesRecycleAdapter`** (Queue, Episodes→New, Episodes→Favorites) — added `ViewHolder.resetSwipeState()` which clears `translationX/Y` and `alpha`, called from `onBindViewHolder()`. This makes a re-bound (recycled) row always render in place, regardless of leftover drag/swipe state. During an active drag/swipe `ItemTouchHelper` re-applies the translation on every draw frame, so this is safe.
3. **`saveScrollPosition()`** in both fragments — bail out when `findFirstVisibleItemPosition()` returns `NO_POSITION` instead of persisting `-1` as the scroll position (which silently destroyed the saved position whenever the list was empty).

Verified with `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**.
